messages:
Joanna: Quick heads-up — I'm about to land a slim refactor on the `payments` TF module that hoists provider blocks and replaces a few direct provider pins with a provider aliasing pattern. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4821

Joanna: Main risk is lockfile churn + our k8s secretpath for the billing service. I ran a local plan but want a quick compatibility sanity before we regen lockfiles for staging.

Sam: ping @Joanna — is the hoist changing provider source or just moving blocks to root?

Joanna: Moving blocks to root + changing some modules to accept `providers = { aws = aws.billing }` instead of inheriting. Not changing source versions except where module uses deprecated provider config.

Alex: Can you paste the minimal diff for provider block so I can scan?

Joanna: Sure — snippet:
```hcl
# before (module/foo/main.tf)
provider "aws" {
  region = var.region
}

# after (root/main.tf)
provider "aws" {
  alias  = "billing"
  region = var.region
}

module "foo" {
  source   = "../modules/foo"
  providers = { aws = aws.billing }
}
```

Priya: This looks fine. Two asks: 1) make sure any `aws_iam_role` resources keep the same assume role behavior (aliasing can affect implicit provider lookup), 2) check k8s secret path mapping — we store KMS key arn in `secretmanager` path which is referenced by module via `data.external` in a few places.

Joanna: Good call. I inspected `iam.tf` and nothing changes for assume roles. For secrets, I'm updating module var from `kms_key` to `kms_key_ref` and passing the same secret path so no value change.

Sam: Can you run `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` in a clean workspace and attach lockfile diff? Want to confirm no new provider downloads.

Joanna: Running now, will push lockfile diff to PR.

infra-bot: CI started for PR #4821 — plan job queued (runner: infra-plan-2).

Mike: Quick FYI — if the lockfile changes, we'll need to coordinate with the Dedicated team. They pin provider hashes in their build image. Might require a small image rebuild window.

Joanna: Noted — tagging the Dedicated oncall in the PR description.

Joanna: Lockfile regen finished locally, small changes: aws provider bumped patch hash due to provider mirrors; no new major versions. Pushing diff now.

Alex: LGTM to review tomorrow morning. Small nit: add a changelog note about `provider aliasing` for module consumers.

Sam: Thumbs up from me. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: CI plan succeeded for PR #4821 — no diffs to remote state detected.

Joanna: Thanks all — I'll wait for Dedicated ack and then merge after lunch if no issues.

Priya: If you want, I can run a quick smoke deploy to staging once merged (k8s secret path + billing svc).

Joanna: Please do, appreciated.

Mike: Noted, Dedicated team is on standby for the image rebuild if CI or staging shows provider mismatch.

Joanna: Closing the loop here. Will post a short post-merge blurb in #eng-deploys when it's done.
